normalization.note: K_REAL is the empirical normalization/capacity scale used by the hard architecture; internal grouped validation is not an external test.

full_observed_horizon_PINN_vs_exact_11FR.scope: control through its observed horizon; treated doses through 48 h; no treated 86-h endpoint

data_fit_comparison.model: Exact 11F-R ODE at same frozen parameters

matched_objective_comparison.scope: control through its observed horizon; treated doses through 48 h; no treated 86-h endpoint

full_observed_horizon_PINN_vs_exact_11FR.interpretation: This is a same-parameter mechanistic-consistency audit. Numerical differences are reported directly; no arbitrary acceptance threshold is imposed.

R3.10_endpoint_validation.forecast_definition: Exact final 11F-R ODE propagation from exact observed 48-h B/qR states to 86 h using the frozen final inverse parameters.

scientific_scope.hard_constraints: The architecture analytically enforces non-negativity and normalized capacity/simplex feasibility; numerical audits verify implementation.
scientific_scope.parameter_interpretation: Real-data inverse parameters are model-conditioned/effective estimates. Because ground-truth biological parameters are unavailable, they must not be presented as uniquely identified biological constants without separate identifiability evidence.
scientific_scope.R3.10_scope: The 86-h treated observations are independent and unpaired. Report only distribution-level validation, never individual 48-to-86 h replicate errors.
